source: Most said they felt just average
claim: 79.5% of participants rated their mood before the conversation in the average band of 4 to 7, versus 4.9% in the negative band up to 3 and 15.5% in the positive band above 7.

source: At the beginning of the conversation, many people said they felt the same or worse than before the call!
claim: 70.6% of participants rated their mood at the beginning of the conversation as the same as or worse than before the call.

source: At the beginning of the conversation, most people felt the same as they did before the call.
claim: 41.8% of participants rated their mood at the beginning the same as before the call, more than the 29.4% who felt better and the 28.7% who felt worse.

source: By the middle of the conversation, a huge portion of people reported feeling better than at the start of the conversation.
claim: 58.0% of participants reported feeling better at the middle of the conversation than at its start.

source: By the end of the call, the large majority of people said they felt better than when the conversation began.
claim: 66.1% of participants reported feeling better at the end of the call than when the conversation began.

source: Here’s how much positive feelings increased on average in all 1,700 conversations:
claim: Average positive feeling rose from 6.1 before the conversation to 7.4 at the end, passing through 6.2 at the beginning and 6.9 in the middle.

source: People enjoyed talking to people, young and old.
claim: Average positive feeling at the end was between 7.30 and 7.55 for every age gap from 0 to 40 years (7.37 at 0, 7.30 at 10, 7.44 at 20, 7.51 at 30 and 7.55 at 40), while beginning scores ranged from 6.06 to 6.48.

source: Interracial conversations tended to lead to positive experiences about as much as they did for people of the same race.
claim: Average positive feeling at the end was 7.44 for same-race pairs and 7.32 for interracial pairs, and at the beginning 6.20 versus 6.11.

source: And most conversations between people with the ↑ same political ideology and ↓ differing political ideologies also had similar outcomes.
claim: Average positive feeling at the end ranged from 7.06 to 7.44 across political differences of zero to five points, and at the beginning from 6.11 to 6.21.
